Stack Bowls.name: Stack Bowls
Stack Bowls.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end. Overlapping means a bowl rests partly on another after release. For three bowls, all three must form one connected arrangement. Stacked means properly nested and stable.

Sort Objects.name: Classify Objects
Sort Objects.guidance:
Grade the final state of the trial. There are two categories with three objects each and two baskets.
Assign a different category to each basket. If the setup specifies the assignment, use it. Otherwise either assignment is acceptable: use the assignment giving the higher total, with one basket per category. Do not count the same category in both baskets.
Score each basket separately:
0 - Empty, mixed (contains objects from both categories), or contains only objects of the category assigned to the other basket.
0.17 - One object of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
0.33 - Two objects of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
0.5 - All three objects of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
Add the two basket scores and select the matching total below. Mixed baskets always score zero. Maximum total is 1.0. Use the agreed decimal scores as written (for example, 0.17 + 0.17 = 0.34 and 0.33 + 0.33 = 0.66).

Pack And Pour Fruit.name: Pack And Pour Fruit
Pack And Pour Fruit.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end. EXCEPTION: Packing scores 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 retain credit once achieved, even if later spilling or unsuccessful pouring undoes that progress. Count the maximum number simultaneously contained in the small bowl, not cumulative placements. Scores 0.7 through 1.0 require all three fruits to have been packed first; 0.7 requires lifting with all three still inside. Pouring credit requires transfer by pouring, not direct placement, and the poured fruit must remain in the large bowl at trial end. Examples: two packed then spilled = 0.3; three packed then spilled before lifting = 0.5; lifted with all three then all spilled = 0.7.
